Metadata.title: CAPCOM — Product Analytics
Metadata.description: CAPCOM: a multitenant product-analytics platform — events, funnels, retention cohorts, and segmentation.

Landing.metaDescription: CAPCOM is a multitenant product-analytics demo — events, funnels, retention cohorts, and segmentation over real Postgres Row-Level Security — built as a live demonstration of the claude-code-nextjs-starter methodology.

hero.eyebrow: Product analytics, built in the open
hero.title: CAPCOM
hero.tagline: A multitenant product-analytics platform — events, funnels, retention cohorts, and segmentation over real Postgres Row-Level Security.
hero.lead: A live demonstration of the claude-code-nextjs-starter methodology: every decision recorded as an ADR, a human acceptance gate, and deterministic checks on every change. The data is seeded — the multitenancy, RBAC, and SQL aggregations are real.

surfaces.heading: What the demo showcases
surfaces.lead: Six analytics surfaces, each an end-to-end vertical slice: in-database SQL aggregation → typed RPC → shareable URL state → token-governed visx chart.

trends.title: Trends
trends.body: Time-bucketed event counts with an optional property breakdown — zero-filled in SQL, never looped in application code.

funnels.title: Funnels
funnels.body: Ordered-step conversion within a single window, counting distinct users from each one's first touch.

retention.title: Retention cohorts
retention.body: The signature dense heatmap — acquisition cohorts, calendar-aligned periods, classic active-in-period retention.

segments.title: Segmentation
segments.body: User-authored attribute and behaviour rules, evaluated by a closed in-database interpreter with no dynamic SQL.

dashboards.title: Dashboards & saved reports
dashboards.body: Saved analyses composed onto boards through Server Actions with optimistic mutations, gated by write-RBAC.

ai.title: Ask with AI
ai.body: A plain-language question translated server-side into a validated query spec that deep-links to the matching surface.

demo.heading: Try it yourself
demo.lead: Sign in with a seeded account and explore real multitenant data. Each account carries a different role, so you can watch RBAC change what you can see and do.
demo.note: Data is seeded and isolated per tenant by Postgres Row-Level Security.

methodology.heading: Behind the scenes
methodology.lead: The point isn't only the product — it's how it's built. Every surface above rides the same governed pipeline.

adr.title: Decisions-first
adr.body: Every non-trivial choice is an ADR, accepted by a human before any code depends on it.

rls.title: Real RLS isolation
rls.body: Multitenancy and RBAC are enforced in Postgres Row-Level Security, not in the application layer.

sql.title: In-database aggregation
sql.body: Funnels, retention, and trends are SECURITY INVOKER SQL functions that run under the caller's RLS.

tokens.title: Token & FSD governance
tokens.body: Every color comes from a generated design-token allowlist; the layered architecture is gated on every commit.

tests.title: A real test pyramid
tests.body: Unit tests, Storybook accessibility checks, and Playwright end-to-end coverage on the auth/RLS critical path.

footer.tagline: Built as a portfolio demonstration of the claude-code-nextjs-starter methodology. The data is seeded; the engineering is real.

AiQuery.description: Describe the analysis you want in plain language. The question is translated into one of your analytics surfaces.
